documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Standard subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Refunds return to the original payment method.

documents.title: Account security
documents.text: Administrators must enable multi-factor authentication. Security incidents must be reported within one hour.

documents.title: Support service levels
documents.text: Priority-one tickets receive an initial response within 30 minutes. Priority-two tickets receive a response within four hours.

documents.title: Billing cycles
documents.text: Annual plans renew on the subscription anniversary. Customers receive a reminder seven days before renewal.
